inputPlaceholder: Ask something or request an automation…
completeSetupToMessage: Complete chat setup to start messaging.
providerNeedsLogin: {{label}} is available once you sign in.
noScriptingNamespaces: No scripting namespaces are currently available.
loginUnavailable: This provider requires login, but its authentication context '{{context}}' is not configured. Contact the deployment operator.
readyStartOrSend: Ready. Start a new chat or send a message to begin.
providerNoModels: The selected provider has no available models.
settingsDescription: Configure the model personality, verbosity and viewer control access.
consentModeLegend: What the assistant can access from this case
consentModeIntro: This chat sends your messages to the selected AI provider. The options below control how much of the open case the assistant may read and act on — it can only touch what you enable here.
consentModeAllButPatientDesc: Assistant can read and control the viewer (slides, annotations, measurements) but never patient identity data. Recommended.
consentModeAllDesc: Also grants access to patient identity data. Use only when the provider is trusted with this information.
consentModeCustomDesc: Pick exactly which capabilities the assistant may use from the list below.
consentAutoApprovedTooltip: Access remembered ({{mode}}) until {{date}} — click to review
providerKeysDescription: Add your own API key to use a provider the administrator did not configure. Keys are stored on the server for your account or session only — never in this browser.
usageDescription: Tokens reported by the model provider for the conversation open in this tab.
usageNone: No recent requests yet in this conversation.
usageNotReported: This provider did not report token counts. OpenAI-compatible endpoints only return them when "Report token usage" is enabled in the provider settings — some older or stricter backends reject that request, which is why it is off by default.
usageDisclaimer: Counted in this browser tab since the conversation was opened, and reset when you reload. Not a billing figure — no pricing is applied. A dash means the provider does not report that number.
providerKeySaved: API key saved. It applies to your account or current session only.
providerKeyFailed: Failed to update the API key. See console for details.
providerKeyLoginFirst: Log in to this provider first to manage your API key.
providerKeyRequiredStatus: This provider needs an API key.
providerSelectedLogInFirst: Provider selected. Please log in first.
loginSuccessful: Login successful. Review chat settings to continue.
loginFailed: Login failed. Please try again. See console for details.
readyStartOrChoose: Ready. Start a new chat or choose an existing session.
failedToLoadSession: Failed to load the selected session.
providerReturnedNoModels: Provider '{{provider}}' did not return any models.
emptyTranscriptHint: No messages yet. Ask about the slide, or describe what you want to see.
emptyTranscriptDictation: A dictation is using this session. What is said is recorded for it, not shown here.
failedToStartSession: Failed to start a new chat session.
imageUploadUnavailable: Screenshot/image upload unavailable for this model.
fileUploadUnavailable: File upload unavailable for this model.
attachmentAdded: Attachment added to the current chat.
fileCouldNotAttach: The file could not be attached.
screenshotAttached: Screenshot attached to the current chat.
screenshotAttachedIncomplete: Screenshot attached, but the view had not finished loading — parts of it are blank.
screenshotIncompleteNote: Note: this screenshot was taken while the viewer was still loading image tiles, so parts of it are blank or missing. Those blank areas are a loading artefact — they are not empty specimen and not a rendering fault. Judge only the areas that rendered, and say so if the answer depends on a region that did not.
screenshotCouldNotAttach: The screenshot could not be attached.
screenshotAndFileUnavailable: Screenshot unavailable. File upload unavailable for this model.
noViewerScreenshotAvailable: No active viewer screenshot is available.
assistantCouldNotComplete: The assistant could not complete this turn.
turnPayloadTooLarge: That message was too large to send and was not delivered. Try again with a smaller attachment or shorter text — the conversation is still usable.
utteranceNotSaved: Could not save the note — it stays in this conversation only.
utteranceReturnedToInput: Could not add the note — the text was kept in the message box.
repeatedScriptFailures: The assistant tried {{count}} times and stopped. Last error: {{error}} Open the developer console for full details, or rephrase the request.
scriptTransportCorrupted: The assistant's code arrived damaged and could not be run ({{detail}}). This is a fault in the model connection, not in your request — try again, or switch to a different model.
scriptTransportCorruptedShort: Stopped: the assistant's code arrived damaged.
scriptRepeatedIdentical: The assistant repeated the same step without making progress and stopped. Rephrase the request or try a different model.
retryingAfterCorruptedScript: The code arrived damaged — asking for it again…
malformedScriptHint: The assistant's code did not arrive intact — retrying…
stepLimitNoFinalAnswer:
The assistant reached the scripting step limit and did not produce a final user-facing answer.

Start a new turn and ask it to summarize what it found so far without further scripting.
turnEndedWithoutAnswer: The turn ended without an answer ({{reason}}). This is a bug — please report it. Open the developer console for details.
historyTruncatedHint: Older messages were trimmed to fit the model's context — restate earlier details if they still matter.
outputTruncatedHint: The reply hit the length limit and was cut off — any script in it was left unfinished and did not run. Ask it to continue in smaller steps.
emptyReplyHint: The reply contained nothing this runtime could use — retrying.
emptyReplies: The assistant produced {{count}} unusable replies in a row and stopped. Its model may be answering in a format this runtime cannot read. Open the developer console for details, or try a different model.
sessionProviderUnavailableHint: This chat's provider is no longer available. Pick a provider to continue it.
attachScreenshotViewport: Attach a screenshot of the current viewer viewport
fileUploadUnavailableForModel: File upload unavailable for this model
